title: Organising Time Between Study, Play, and Screens
summary: The multitude of tasks and digital temptations scatter your child’s focus. Teach him to organise his time himself instead of organising it for him: a simple schedule that balances duty, rest, play, and screen time. The skill he builds now in managing his time will serve him throughout his life more than any lesson.
try_this: This week: Help your child create a simple daily schedule that he writes himself, balancing study, rest, and screen time.
reflection_prompts: How does your child organise his time now?
Is the schedule his own creation?
